findings.title: 6 of 23 command files modified in W01/W03 use prose or '/mcp <server> <tool>' syntax and are completely unguarded by the drift gate
findings.body: check_mcp_tool_refs and check_mcp_servers (lines 48-51, 97-133) only scan the 'mcp__<server>__<tool>' token form. As a result, 4 W01 files (bootstrap.md:5, doc-pull.md:5, mem/summarize.md:8, and search-decisions.md:2 '/mcp conport search_content') and 2 W03 files (plan.md:1 and plan-tasks.md:2) have zero matches under _mcp_refs. Instead of scanning '/mcp <server> <tool>' with an explicit exemption set for pre-existing 'zen' (analogous to UNVERIFIED_SERVERS), omitting the scan leaves search-decisions.md and the W03 repoints in plan.md and plan-tasks.md unverified against mcp_tool_surfaces.json. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-001/review_bundle/AUDIT02_ADJUDICATION.md

findings.title: W03 introduces 'pal-stdio' server name in plan.md while dx/implement.md and UNVERIFIED_SERVERS use 'pal', and plan-tasks.md repoints to 'create_work_tree' in prose without surface verification
findings.body: Authority Facts claim F4 ('pal vs pal-stdio naming in dx/implement.md and dx/note.md') is pre-existing, but plan.md:1 was modified in W03 to say 'Use the PAL `planner` tool (MCP server `pal-stdio`)', whereas dx/implement.md:8-9 and test_claude_command_references.py:30 (UNVERIFIED_SERVERS) use 'pal'. Similarly, plan-tasks.md:2 was changed from '/mcp task-master-ai create_tasks' to prose 'Call the `create_work_tree` MCP tool on the `task-orchestrator` server'; had these been written as mcp__pal-stdio__planner and mcp__task-orchestrator__create_work_tree, check_mcp_servers and check_mcp_tool_refs would have enforced server/tool verification. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-001/review_bundle/AUDIT02_ADJUDICATION.md

findings.title: _MCP_REF omits underscores in server names and lacks a trailing token boundary on _MCP_TOOL
findings.body: At line 47-48, _MCP_TOOL = r'(\*|[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9_]+)*)' and _MCP_REF = re.compile(r'mcp__([A-Za-z0-9-]+)__' + _MCP_TOOL). Unlike src/dopemux/mcp/fleet_catalog.py:31 (r'\bmcp__([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)__([A-Za-z0-9_-]+|\*)'), _MCP_REF does not match server names containing underscores (e.g. mcp__some_server__tool is silently ignored), and because _MCP_TOOL has no trailing boundary, malformed tool tokens like 'mcp__conport__get_context--bad' or 'mcp__conport__*bad' match the valid prefix ('get_context' or '*') and falsely pass. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-001/review_bundle/AUDIT02_ADJUDICATION.md

findings.title: Disclosed ConPort SSE semantic limitations: category-wide custom_data fetches, client-side search truncation, and unverified update_context merge vs overwrite behavior
findings.body: (1) bootstrap.md:5, caveat.md:14, mem-query.md:10-12, mem-search.md:8-9, and mem/summarize.md:8 replace FTS custom_data queries with get_custom_data(workspace_id, category='caveats'|'mem'|'scratch'), which returns all entries in the category without server-side query filtering or result limits. (2) search_content has no server-side limit parameter, shifting top-N truncation to the prompt. (3) dx/implement.md:131,283 and research-deep.md:16 pass context_data={...} to update_context instead of patch_content={...}; if the live server replaces rather than merges the context dict, partial updates will overwrite other keys in active context. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-001/review_bundle/AUDIT02_ADJUDICATION.md
